resources.string: Text recognition, extraction, and optional Qwen or Gemini Nano processing run on this device. Cloud AI is disabled in this build.

Saved records use an encrypted database. Media and search vectors use app-private storage protected by Android; they are outside that database encryption. Widgets show shortcuts only, and reminder previews hide document details.
Model downloads, links you open, sharing, and exports can use the network or another app. This screen describes the configured behavior; it does not measure network traffic.
Calendar access is optional and read-only. Selected events are cached locally; disconnecting clears the cached records.
